import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_3.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold DataFrames from each source
    dfs = []

    # Load each source CSV fully
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Extract only the 'TrackID' column as per target schema
    # Convert TrackID to integer type explicitly
    combined_df['TrackID'] = combined_df['TrackID'].astype(int)

    # Drop duplicates to get unique TrackID values
    target_df = combined_df[['TrackID']].drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Sort by TrackID for consistent output
    target_df = target_df.sort_values(by='TrackID').reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
